title: 8 Things That Feel Like Godly Humility but Are Actually Just Fear
caption:
Never speaking up in the room isn't humility. It's hoping nobody notices you.

Refusing a compliment, staying quiet when you're right, apologizing for things that weren't your fault: most of it isn't lowliness. It's fear that learned to dress well.

Real humility can tell the difference between owning your sin and just making the discomfort stop.
